caption:
A lead fills out your quiz. Ninety seconds later they're booked.

Here's what runs behind the scenes when follow-up isn't manual:

1. Form submits, contact lands in your CRM
2. Answers score and route the lead to the right stage
3. A text goes out before 60 seconds pass
4. Your team gets pinged the moment a human is needed
5. The lead books straight off your live calendar

Most shops still do this by hand, if they do it at all.

Industry data shows only 17% of service businesses answer a lead within an hour. Replying in under 5 minutes can double your close rate.

Example workflow. Illustrative, not a specific client account.
